about: Every control that issues a command (brief 20, D1), read from the code by tools/wiring.mjs at c4832549: each call of the game's run in src/ui and src/app, the control it sits under (its tag and handler, its guide lock where it has one, its label as the JSX draws it), the kind it issues and the payload's source; beside them a decision's answers (requireDecision's actions, drawn on Home as buttons that issue world.take_decision_action with the answer's index) and a stop's own choices (defineStop). Each line was read against its command's handler, named in `handler` (file:line of its registration): `verdict` says whether the label says what the command does to the thing the control is on, and `note` says why where that needed more than the line. tests/b20-guide-wiring.test.ts holds the list to the code, every kind to a registered command, every key sent to a key its handler takes, each lock to its own command's chapter, and every registered command to some control. A control added or changed fails that test until `node tools/wiring.mjs --write` writes it in and its reading is filled.

controls.label: {choice.label}
controls.handler: src/engine/world/clock.ts:58 (stopChoices: calendar.skip, school.cancel_rehearsal, pro.ask_to_move, each declared by defineStop)
controls.note: A stop's own choice (`stopChoices`): Skip It sends calendar.skip with the stopped plan's id, Call It Off school.cancel_rehearsal with the stopped rehearsal's ids, and Ask To Move pro.ask_to_move with the stopped meeting's id. Its lock is the same command. tests/b20-guide-wiring.test.ts resolves the kind to `stopCommands()`.
